Thank you for visiting! I have been a REALTOR since 2005 serving Jackson County and surrounding areas. 

My Team is amazing and we all work together to give you the Best Experience in Buying or Selling your Home! You need attention to detail, constant communication and someone to help you navigate the process with you! It takes a Village and we are so honored to walk with you during this exciting time in your life. 

Heather Herndon, REALTOR, Listing and Buyers Agent and Team Leader

Teri Daniels, REALTOR

Ruth Gundy, REALTOR

Kelly Talbert, REALTOR

Lloyd Herndon, REALTOR

Erin Axon, REALTOR

Connor Talbert, REALTOR

Jen Biela, Team Administrator

We look forward to guiding you through the home buying or selling process.

You can count on a Comprehensive Marketing Plan, Integrity, Knowledge, Attentive to your Needs, Attention to Detail and Professional Service.
